title: Forest Society and Colonialism
subtitle: Understanding the Impact of Colonial Rule on Forests and Forest Dwellers
subject: Social Science (History)
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand the reasons for commercial forestry introduced by the British.
Analyze the impact of scientific forestry on the lives of forest dwellers.
Learn about the rebellions in the forest regions against colonial rules.
Examine the changes in forest management across India and Java.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the chronological and causal understanding of how colonialism exploited forest resources and disrupted indigenous societies.
common_misconceptions: Assuming deforestation only started recently for urbanization.
Thinking 'Scientific Forestry' actually meant preservation of forests rather than commercial exploitation.
Believing tribal rebellions were uncoordinated riots rather than organized resistance.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If a student struggles with why tribals rebelled, ask them to imagine someone suddenly taking away their home and only source of livelihood.
